question: In terms of ordering logistics, I’m hoping the process will be similar to my last purchase. I’ve gotten used to your checkout system, but I’d like to confirm if there’s any discount or promotional offer I can use for returning customers. Originally, I benefited from that first-time buyer discount. Now that I’m making a second purchase, is there a loyalty or referral program? If so, it might motivate me to grab even more accessories—or maybe it’ll help me justify an upgraded version of the grinder if one exists. You know I’m always looking for ways to save a bit of money, especially since as a freelancer, I prefer to keep close tabs on all my expenses. But trust me, I also don’t mind investing in a product that will last for the long haul.
fn_call: archival_memory_retrieve(query='loyalty program or referral offer for returning customers, especially for coffee grinder or accessories bundle',top_k=20)

trace.draft: No current loyalty or referral program is available for returning customers. First-time buyer discounts are not applicable to repeat purchases. However, we do offer a 10% discount on accessories when purchased with a qualifying appliance—this could help justify an upgraded grinder or accessory bundle. For future promotions, sign up for our email newsletter to be the first to know about seasonal offers.
